title: Schedule
description: spec of the Schedule manifest: slots by cron, a time zone, a task and an address (docs/task-language.md, "Schedule"). Exactly one of task and script is set (lint schedule_target); task is the only form until v0.2.

cron.description: Five cron fields, without CRON_TZ and TZ (TIM-3).

timezone.description: Time zone; without the field Tenant.spec.timezone applies.

task.description: The slot task: a type from the system-ops group.

script.description: From v0.2: name of a kind: Script manifest reviewed in the tenant's git that the slot starts without a person's button; only a script that needs no script.run (SCR-12).

skip_if_waiting.description: true by default: the slot is skipped while the previous task waits (TIM-3).

paused.description: From v0.2: true pauses the schedule, and each of its slots is skipped with schedule.skipped(paused) and not caught up; false by default (TIM-5). A proposal sets it only with the kind none (PRP-10).

proposable.description: Whether a change of the schedule can be proposed; true by default (PRP-10).

locale.description: From v0.2: the language of code texts for the schedule's addresses (DLV-9).
